# Wonderworld Labs

> Official Android app information. Each app page and privacy policy is the source of truth. Public download availability is not confirmed for every app and account.

## Official pages
- [Home](https://wonderworldlabs.com/)
- [All Android apps](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/)
- [Android guides](https://wonderworldlabs.com/guides/)

## Apps
- [Melody Garden](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/melody-garden/): Melody Garden is an Android app for learning piano and guitar with offline lessons and on-screen practice. Microphone feedback is optional, and lesson progress stays on your device.
- [Arrow unleashed](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/arrow-unleashed/): Arrow unleashed is an Android arrow puzzle game for offline play, with daily challenges, hints and local milestones. Ordinary puzzles do not require an account or a constant connection.
- [The Whispering Diary](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/whispering-diary/): The Whispering Diary is an adults-only Android app for fictional AI chats with Elias. After an initial model download of approximately 805 MB, ordinary conversations run locally on the device.
- [Photo & File Vault](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/photo-file-vault/): Photo & File Vault keeps encrypted copies of selected photos and files in an offline Android vault. No recovery service is provided for a lost unlock secret, and exported files are unencrypted.
- [Block Blasting](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/block-blasting/): Block Blasting is an offline Android block puzzle game with Classic mode and 24 Adventure levels. Best scores, badges and preferences are saved locally without an account or ads.
- [Explain Studio](https://wonderworldlabs.com/apps/explain-studio/): Explain Studio is an Android video recording and editing app with a teleprompter, optional on-device English voice follow, and local video rendering. AI assets are made outside the app and imported.

## Browser games
- [Ladderday](https://wonderworldlabs.com/games/ladderday/): Daily word ladders. Play at https://ladderday.wonderworldlabs.com/
- [Scale Safari](https://wonderworldlabs.com/games/scale-safari/): Visual estimation & size puzzles. Play at https://scale-safari.wonderworldlabs.com/
- [Linkloom](https://wonderworldlabs.com/games/linkloom/): Pyramid word & number puzzles. Play at https://linkloom.wonderworldlabs.com/
- [HintHunt](https://wonderworldlabs.com/games/hinthunt/): Semantic mystery-word game. Play at https://hinthunt.wonderworldlabs.com/
